title: Tide chart gifts
titleArt: Tide chart gifts and tide art prints
description: Gifts from Tide Hours, listed by kind and by town: {kinds}.
intro: Each one is made by Tide Hours. The tide gifts are drawn from the same tide predictions as this site: art, not for navigation, and not a NOAA product.
how: They are listed by kind, and by town within each kind. A town's name links to its tide times on this site, and each gift links to where it is sold, on {stores}.

custom.heading: Custom tide chart prints
custom.text: A made-to-order print of the predicted tide at one place on one day, such as a wedding, a birth or the day you met, with a line of your own words. It is a digital file that you print. Order it in the

daylight.heading: Winter solstice print
daylight.text: The winter solstice in your city, December 21, {year}: the shortest day of the year, and the first bar on the page. After it come the 364 days to December 20, {next}, one thin bar for each, from midnight at the top to midnight at the bottom, so you can watch the light come back through spring to the long days of June and out again. Made to order as a digital file, for any city in the 50 states, Puerto Rico or the U.S. Virgin Islands; not interior or northern Alaska, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands or American Samoa.

rings.heading: Tide rings art prints
rings.text: A town's whole {year} tide year drawn as rings, like the rings of a tree, one ring for each lunar month. A printable digital download.

posters.heading: Year-of-tides posters
posters.text: A whole {year} year of predicted highs and lows at one town on one sheet, a ribbon for each month. A printable digital download.

calendars.heading: Printable {year} tide calendars
calendars.text: Every predicted high and low tide of the year at one town, a month to a page, with the lowest tides of each month marked. Printable PDFs in US Letter and A4.

blanket.heading: Tide blanket patterns
blanket.text: A printable color chart for a knitted or crocheted {year} tide blanket: one row for each day of the year at one town, its color set by that day's tidal range, like a temperature blanket.

stitch.heading: Cross-stitch patterns
stitch.text: Full cross stitches only, 2 strands: no backstitch, no half or quarter stitches. No fabric, thread or kit is shipped. There are no month marks, times or heights on it: it is a picture of the year, not a calendar or a tide table.

book.heading: Printed tide tables
book.text: Tide tables printed and bound as a book, sold on Amazon.

moon.text: The {year} phases of the moon, for the time zones each one names. They show the moon, not the tide.
